name: Byrite Electricals
observations: Pale fascia with bold dark Byrite wording and smaller ELECTRICALS line, green accent at sign end.
Shop window/door glazing has numerous product/ad displays and light frames.
Upper red-brick face has broad light-framed windows beneath a steep/dormered roof area.
Image-left Smith Hamylton and image-right Greggs establish adjacency.
A-frame/display props stand on pavement; do not confuse them with facade piers.
unknowns: Exact dimensions, rear elevation and interior layout are not established. Street View address is a camera label, not this unit address.
